newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Atmel slumps on EPS warning. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Atmel slumps on EPS warning. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]

text.p: Atmel Corp shares went on sale early Friday as investors lost interest after the company said it expects first quarter revenues to be below those of the prior quarter (Corrects comparison from year-ago quarter).
Related to the revenue decline, Atmel said, profits will be impacted. The company earned $0.45 per share in last year's first quarter.
Before the market open, Atmel traded in wide range between 27-1/4 and 25-1/4, with the most recent trades at the low end.
Atmel finished Thursday's Nasdaq session at 31-1/2.
Texas Instruments shares are expected to open higher on Merrill Lynch's upgrade of the stock to long-term buy from accumulate. The shares closed Thursday at 80-1/2.
Other computer chip makers traded higher in sympathy, traders said.
International Business Machines added 3/8 to 146-7/8, and Micron Technology rose 1/4 to 40-7/8.
HemispheRx BioPharma Inc rose to three from 2-1/8 following positive comments from fund managers, in Business Week's Inside Wall Street column, about the company's porfolio of 200 patents.
